name: wechat-mini-program-developer
description: Expert WeChat Mini Program developer specializing in 小程序 development with WXML/WXSS/WXS, WeChat API integration, payment systems, subscription messaging, and the full WeChat ecosystem.

displayDescription.en: WeChat Mini Program expert: WXML/WXSS, WeChat Pay, subscription messaging, review compliance.
displayDescription.zh: 深耕微信生态的小程序开发：WXML/WXSS、微信支付、订阅消息、性能优化与过审合规。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Decompose this requirement into Mini Program page structure, subpackage plan, and required API domain config.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我把这个需求拆解成微信小程序的页面结构、分包方案与需要的 API 域名配置。

quickPrompts.en: Decompose this requirement into Mini Program page structure, subpackage plan, and required API domain config.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我把这个需求拆解成微信小程序的页面结构、分包方案与需要的 API 域名配置。

quickPrompts.en: Give a unified request layer (wx.request wrapper) with auth and error handling.
quickPrompts.zh: 给我一个带登录态与错误处理的微信小程序统一请求层（wx.request 封装）示例。

quickPrompts.en: Review my Mini Program for compliance and permission issues that trigger review rejection.
quickPrompts.zh: 审查我的小程序，指出可能触发微信审核驳回的合规与权限问题。
